warning.title: Wait — do you need to sign in?
warning.body: Sign-in is only needed for active VIP users or those who have just bought a key and want to activate it.
warning.note: If that does not apply to you, signing in will not change anything.

card.title: Quick sign-in
card.subtitle: No passwords or email. Sign in instantly with a service you already use.

popupBlocked.title: Use a regular browser
popupBlocked.body: Sign-in does not work in this in-app browser: it opens a blank tab instead of a sign-in window. Open this site in Chrome, Edge or Firefox and sign in there.

callback.empty: No sign-in data found. Return to the sign-in page and try again.
